auth_mode: RAM identity via Alibaba Cloud CLI; credentials redacted and never stored
necessity_in_sceneguard: Read-only discovery verifies the official cloud Skill chain and confirms candidate OSS evidence destinations before any write integration.

failure_case.fallback: Keep evidence in the local hash-verified submission bundle; do not retry writes blindly.

replacement_strategy: Replace the discovery call with a read-only ResourceCenter API/CLI adapter behind the same evidence contract; estimated migration is one adapter and contract test, with no pipeline rewrite.
